boolean-defaults.cause: Null is treated as absent by ?? defaults, truthiness dispatch, or overwritten options; runtime boolean validation is missing before permission handling.
boolean-defaults.fix: Validate present boolean values before defaults and all wrapper transformations; undefined alone activates defaults.
regressions: All declared booleans reject null, 0, 1, strings and objects before service calls or permission prompts.
Omitted values use defaults; explicit false remains false; valid true/false requests retain successful controls.

plaintext-before-encryption.cause: The permissions wrapper encrypts the one-byte plaintext description before SDK minimum-length validation, so the ciphertext satisfies the minimum.
plaintext-before-encryption.fix: Validate caller plaintext before any encryption or permission side effect; retain separate internal encrypted-metadata handling.
regressions: Lengths 4/5/2000/2001 measured in UTF-8 bytes reject/accept before encryption.
Valid descriptions encrypt at rest and round-trip to the exact original plaintext.

inactive-privilege-parameters.cause: Wallet routes to ProtoWallet on falsy privileged; ProtoWallet does not validate privilegedReason when unused.
inactive-privilege-parameters.fix: Validate all present privilege parameters before mode dispatch. Optional unsupported privileged capability remains a separate applicability obligation.
regressions: Malformed privilegedReason rejects with privileged omitted/false/true.
Valid normal-key operations succeed without proving secondary-key support.

counterparty-null-default.cause: Crypto methods coalesce explicit null to self/anyone before key derivation.
counterparty-null-default.fix: Validate every present counterparty before applying undefined-only defaults.
regressions: Reject null and malformed compressed public keys; preserve self/anyone and valid peer-key independent crypto results.

byte-domain.cause: Crypto operations hash/encrypt/sign unchecked JavaScript numeric arrays; negative elements reach byte normalization.
byte-domain.fix: Require integer bytes in [0,255] before primitives; validate direct digest length.
regressions: Reject -1,256,fractions,NaN and sparse/non-array values; verify valid boundary bytes against independent crypto implementations.

optional-input-shapes.cause: Optional values and collections are forwarded or ignored without checking their declared type.
optional-input-shapes.fix: Validate present BEEF, strings, enum values, TXIDs and records before branching; validate inactive protocol-specific fields or explicitly version their applicability.
regressions: Null is distinct from undefined; malformed TXID entries fail even in inactive batching branches.
Direct/issuance certificate variants reject malformed present fields while retaining independent successful certificate controls.

shape-check-before-use.cause: Permission or SDK code uses trim/startsWith/Object.keys/Object.entries/spread before type validation, producing a JavaScript engine exception.
shape-check-before-use.fix: Perform reusable runtime shape validation at each public permission-wrapper entry before collection, normalization, encryption or grant lookup. Preserve BRC permission module dispatch for valid values.
regressions: Exercise all 15 original malformed fields through public permission wrappers, with spies proving no grant-store writes, prompts, RPC or funding effects.
Require semantic parameter errors, not mere thrown exceptions; valid paired calls must succeed.

unsigned-integer-rpc-boundary.cause: SDK forwards -1 for unlockingScriptLength, sequenceNumber, lockTime and version; Go public RPC reports HTTP500 and the TS client discards its body before JSON-RPC error decoding. Go decoder attribution is inferred until a same-request direct replay captures it.
unsigned-integer-rpc-boundary.fix: SDK range checks before RPC; independently preserve JSON-RPC invalid-params error envelopes at Go compatibility transport and decode structured non-2xx responses where contracted.
regressions: Reject -1/fractions/overflow at wallet public entry before RPC; accept allowed boundaries.
Direct malformed JSON-RPC request retains request ID and invalid-params error; provider is never invoked.

reserved-namespace-oracle.cause: The native wallet rejects the exact reserved name before underlying execution, but oracle4 excludes every message containing unsupported; this conflates namespace refusal with unimplemented operation.
reserved-namespace-oracle.fix: Prospective oracle5 narrowly recognizes only the pinned source, exact fixture method/arguments, absent result and exact P-module rejection. Keep errors.structured separate and preserve original oracle4 results.
regressions: Only the two reserved predicates change on both immutable originals.
Reject generic unsupported, wrong scheme/context, duplicates, success-plus-error, timeouts and transport failures.

uppercase-protocol-normalization.cause: KeyDeriver lowercases protocol names before applying the lowercase-only regex; uppercase input returns a key.
uppercase-protocol-normalization.fix: Reject noncanonical protocol case at the public protocol boundary before derivation, subject to pinned normative protocol requirements.
regressions: Uppercase protocol rejects; lowercase valid peer derivation still matches independent BRC42 oracle.

public-error-serialization.cause: Yours background reduces Error to error.message; @1sat CWI event transport reconstructs plain Error and loses status/code/description/context.
public-error-serialization.fix: Source-owned JSON error-envelope serialization and revival across background/content/inject, preserving safe structured fields and unknown-error fallback without exposing secrets.
regressions: Round-trip specified parameter errors with status/code/description/context; primitive and unknown thrown values produce stable safe envelopes.
Public rejected promises expose structured fields without leaking stack/private data.

sign-reference-validation.cause: SignAction validator forwards reference without validating base64 before pending-reference lookup, which emits an unrelated unimplemented recovery error.
sign-reference-validation.fix: Validate reference format before pending action/ownership checks; distinguish malformed, unknown valid, wrong-origin and recovered references.
regressions: Malformed reference yields parameter error before storage access; valid unknown reference has typed not-found/recovery behavior; same-owner signing succeeds once.

list-actions-output-contract.cause: One output predicate includes signed net satoshis, null optional arrays, and change metadata absent/empty. Different fields span specification interpretation, Go serialization and native metadata handling; public result alone is insufficient for single-layer attribution.
list-actions-output-contract.fix: Separate field-specific claims; resolve signed-net amount semantics prospectively and normalize absent optional arrays at producer boundary without inventing metadata.
regressions: Use real outgoing/incoming signed actions and include flags; inspect exact satoshis, absent versus null arrays, and change output descriptions/tags.

final-nosend-outpoints.cause: Permission wrapper spreads createResult then signResult; stale pre-sign noSendChange can survive if signResult omits replacement outpoints.
final-nosend-outpoints.fix: Derive final wallet-managed change outpoints from the final signed transaction and verified ownership, preserving optional absence rules.
regressions: Require returned nonempty outpoints to belong to final signed transaction with exact wallet-managed scripts; reject stale pre-sign IDs while valid caller input control succeeds.

broaderCoverageObligations.reason: Optional privileged mode requires artifact-specific admission and a distinct supported user-presence fixture; normal-key execution does not prove it.

Supported basket, certificate, one-shot spending and visible revocation cases have separately frozen mandatory scenarios in this profile. Additional linkage semantics and finite-expiry admission remain separate obligations; no private permission-state mutation is permitted.

The admitted native substrate is window.CWI injection. This artifact does not expose a laboratory-admitted BRC100 byte-wire endpoint; a client-side encoder would test the adapter rather than a native endpoint.
The interface alias limits baskets to300 bytes while namespace prose permits400. This profile tests the unambiguous common subset and does not qualify301–400.

The input/output contract corpus does not prove every batching, default, pagination, certificate issuance and conflicting-parameter combination. Coverage remains explicit until corresponding native stateful fixtures execute.
